text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq holds poetry festival on Sunday in which Arab and foreign poets and writers will take part.
- World countries support Boutros Boutros-Ghali's nomination for a second term as U.N. Secretary-General despite U.S. veto.
- Imam Ali's birthday celebration will be held on Sunday under the auspices of President Saddam Hussein.
- Irrigation Ministry completes dredging of a number of canals in the southern province of Diyala.
- Ministry of Industry and Minerals will organise symposium on Iraq's food industries this month.
- Delegation from Turkey's official Anatolian news agency ends visit to Iraq.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Finland urges quick implementation of Iraq's oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
